spans.text: Please, please, be something of use...

units.rawText: As the Entropization threatens to drag her under, Imhotep's consciousness floats in and out of lucidity, her faint lamentations akin to meaningless ramblings.
units.displayText: As the Entropization threatens to drag her under, Imhotep's consciousness floats in and out of lucidity, her faint lamentations akin to meaningless ramblings.

spans.text: As the Entropization threatens to drag her under, Imhotep's consciousness floats in and out of lucidity, her faint lamentations akin to meaningless ramblings.

units.rawText: Haha... for a vet to fall because of an animal. Perhaps this is one of many things fate decrees...
units.displayText: Haha... for a vet to fall because of an animal. Perhaps this is one of many things fate decrees...

spans.text: Haha... for a vet to fall because of an animal. Perhaps this is one of many things fate decrees...

units.rawText: What a shame...
units.displayText: What a shame...

spans.text: What a shame...

units.rawText: Her strength continues to drain from her voice.
units.displayText: Her strength continues to drain from her voice.

spans.text: Her strength continues to drain from her voice.

units.rawText: Persi kitty... I'd be a truly awful doctor if I were to make my patient cry...
units.displayText: Persi kitty... I'd be a truly awful doctor if I were to make my patient cry...

spans.text: Persi kitty... I'd be a truly awful doctor if I were to make my patient cry...

units.rawText: ...If I do see you again, I'll...
units.displayText: ...If I do see you again, I'll...

spans.text: ...If I do see you again, I'll...

units.rawText: The rest became indistinguishable.
units.displayText: The rest became indistinguishable.

spans.text: The rest became indistinguishable.

units.rawText: Imhotep...
units.displayText: Imhotep...

spans.text: Imhotep...

units.rawText: You were the one who requested assistance from me, but even now, still, you're the one helping me...
units.displayText: You were the one who requested assistance from me, but even now, still, you're the one helping me...

spans.text: You were the one who requested assistance from me, but even now, still, you're the one helping me...

units.rawText: Persicaria draws a deep breath, looking up to the sky for a moment before refocusing on reality.
units.displayText: Persicaria draws a deep breath, looking up to the sky for a moment before refocusing on reality.

spans.text: Persicaria draws a deep breath, looking up to the sky for a moment before refocusing on reality.

units.rawText: Attention, all Oasis units. Heed this report.
units.displayText: Attention, all Oasis units. Heed this report.

spans.text: Attention, all Oasis units. Heed this report.

units.rawText: All teams in Zone C, commencing operational meeting.
units.displayText: All teams in Zone C, commencing operational meeting.

spans.text: All teams in Zone C, commencing operational meeting.

units.rawText: Squads, status report.
units.displayText: Squads, status report.

spans.text: Squads, status report.

units.rawText: Backup data rescue is largely complete. We've additionally acquired the Entropic's general location and can bolster the defenses in that area.
units.displayText: Backup data rescue is largely complete. We've additionally acquired the Entropic's general location and can bolster the defenses in that area.

spans.text: Backup data rescue is largely complete. We've additionally acquired the Entropic's general location and can bolster the defenses in that area.

units.rawText: The Entropization of agents and buildings has been brought under control! The infection will go no further!
units.displayText: The Entropization of agents and buildings has been brought under control! The infection will go no further!

spans.text: The Entropization of agents and buildings has been brought under control! The infection will go no further!

units.rawText: Combat squadron assembled, ready to mobilize against the Entropic.
units.displayText: Combat squadron assembled, ready to mobilize against the Entropic.

spans.text: Combat squadron assembled, ready to mobilize against the Entropic.

units.rawText: Good work, everyone. Now, we begin our counterattack.
units.displayText: Good work, everyone. Now, we begin our counterattack.

spans.text: Good work, everyone. Now, we begin our counterattack.

units.rawText: The unshaken spirit in Persicaria's voice almost manifests itself in everyone present.
units.displayText: The unshaken spirit in Persicaria's voice almost manifests itself in everyone present.

spans.text: The unshaken spirit in Persicaria's voice almost manifests itself in everyone present.

units.rawText: Imhotep's analytical conclusions on the jellyfish has been sent to everyone. I will summarize the conclusions:
units.displayText: Imhotep's analytical conclusions on the jellyfish has been sent to everyone. I will summarize the conclusions:

spans.text: Imhotep's analytical conclusions on the jellyfish has been sent to everyone. I will summarize the conclusions:

units.rawText: Judging from its tracks inside the Oasis, the jellyfish's goal is to Entropize buildings and agents, and prioritize targeting individual entities holding a high amount of operands.
units.displayText: Judging from its tracks inside the Oasis, the jellyfish's goal is to Entropize buildings and agents, and prioritize targeting individual entities holding a high amount of operands.

spans.text: Judging from its tracks inside the Oasis, the jellyfish's goal is to Entropize buildings and agents, and prioritize targeting individual entities holding a high amount of operands.

units.rawText: Additionally, it continually alternates between absorbing operands and spreading the infection, which is how it stays on the move.
units.displayText: Additionally, it continually alternates between absorbing operands and spreading the infection, which is how it stays on the move.

spans.text: Additionally, it continually alternates between absorbing operands and spreading the infection, which is how it stays on the move.

units.rawText: In other words, it's difficult to lock down its coordinates at any time, but we can predict its next target by analyzing the operand distribution in the area?
units.displayText: In other words, it's difficult to lock down its coordinates at any time, but we can predict its next target by analyzing the operand distribution in the area?

spans.text: In other words, it's difficult to lock down its coordinates at any time, but we can predict its next target by analyzing the operand distribution in the area?

units.rawText: Yes, maybe even lure it out using a load of operands.
units.displayText: Yes, maybe even lure it out using a load of operands.

spans.text: Yes, maybe even lure it out using a load of operands.

units.rawText: From the analyzed data, the jellyfish has just expended a great amount of operands in spreading the infection. We can take this chance to remove it once and for all before it replenishes its resources.
units.displayText: From the analyzed data, the jellyfish has just expended a great amount of operands in spreading the infection. We can take this chance to remove it once and for all before it replenishes its resources.

spans.text: From the analyzed data, the jellyfish has just expended a great amount of operands in spreading the infection. We can take this chance to remove it once and for all before it replenishes its resources.

units.rawText: It's as Simo says. We'll all need to do our parts perfectly for this plan.
units.displayText: It's as Simo says. We'll all need to do our parts perfectly for this plan.

spans.text: It's as Simo says. We'll all need to do our parts perfectly for this plan.

units.rawText: Hubble, you and Fresnel prepare a load of operands as a trap for the Entropic.
units.displayText: Hubble, you and Fresnel prepare a load of operands as a trap for the Entropic.

spans.text: Hubble, you and Fresnel prepare a load of operands as a trap for the Entropic.

units.rawText: Simo, lie in ambush, use optical camouflage around the trap with a detachment. When the jellyfish appears, eliminate it.
units.displayText: Simo, lie in ambush, use optical camouflage around the trap with a detachment. When the jellyfish appears, eliminate it.

spans.text: Simo, lie in ambush, use optical camouflage around the trap with a detachment. When the jellyfish appears, eliminate it.

units.rawText: <size=40>Understood!</size>
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: Bonee, make preparations around the location. Prevent the jellyfish from spreading the infection further in its struggles.
units.displayText: Bonee, make preparations around the location. Prevent the jellyfish from spreading the infection further in its struggles.

spans.text: Bonee, make preparations around the location. Prevent the jellyfish from spreading the infection further in its struggles.

units.rawText: O-okay! Got it!
units.displayText: O-okay! Got it!

spans.text: O-okay! Got it!

units.rawText: Send updates when your preparations are complete. Give it your all—we must not let our sacrifices go to waste!
units.displayText: Send updates when your preparations are complete. Give it your all—we must not let our sacrifices go to waste!

spans.text: Send updates when your preparations are complete. Give it your all—we must not let our sacrifices go to waste!

units.rawText: <size=40>Roger!</size>
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.displayText: Sol removes her necklace and places it in Persicaria's palm, the tiny patch of green within the bottle seeming to symbolize the Oasis.
